h1.en: HBT8018 vs LZ-60 Concrete Pump is a catalogue comparison, not a page from Concrete
h1.zh: HBT8018和LZ-60混凝土泵有何不同是目录对照，不是「混凝土」那一页

directAnswer.en: HBT8018 and LZ-60 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that both list pipe 100 / 125 mm and aggregate 4 cm and below. HBT8018 lists a 132 kW motor, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m and height 450 m. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete.
directAnswer.zh: HBT8018 和 LZ-60 是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，管径都标出 100 / 125 mm，骨料都是 4 cm 及以下。HBT8018 标出 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、高度 450 m。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete。

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete. Subject: Bloczek betonowy. HBT8018 and LZ-60 are concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai that both list pipe 100 / 125 mm and aggregate 4 cm and below. Model line: HBT8018 lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. LZ-60 lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Delivery height: HBT8018 lists 450 m. LZ-60 lists 300 m. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Use the split labels, then keep each metre value on the page that lists it. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete。画面主体：Bloczek betonowy。HBT8018 和 LZ-60 是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，管径都标出 100 / 125 mm，骨料都是 4 cm 及以下。理论输送量：HBT8018标出 60 m³/h；LZ-60标出 50 m³/h。外形尺寸：HBT8018标出 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm；LZ-60标出 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。LZ-60有、HBT8018没有的行：发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: HBT8018 lists a 132 kW motor, 60 m³/h, 40 MPa, conveying distance 150 m and height 450 m. Theoretical output: HBT8018 lists 60 m³/h. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h. Dimensions: HBT8018 lists 6700 × 1750 × 1800 mm. LZ-60 lists 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m. HBT8018 lists entries that LZ-60 does not: Motor power 132 kW. Open /en/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/ for HBT8018 and /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60.
body.zh: HBT8018 标出 132 kW 电机、60 m³/h、40 MPa、输送距离 150 m、高度 450 m。泵送压力：HBT8018标出 40 MPa；LZ-60标出 35 MPa。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大骨料粒径两边都是 4 cm and below；输送管内径两边都是 100 / 125 mm。先认出拆开的标题，再把每个米数留在写出它的那一页。

body.en: LZ-60 lists engine 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m and height 300 m. Pumping pressure: HBT8018 lists 40 MPa. LZ-60 lists 35 MPa. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. aggregate size is 4 cm and below on both pages. Delivery pipe diameter is 100 / 125 mm on both pages. LZ-60 lists entries that HBT8018 does not: Engine power 6105 / 145 kW. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: LZ-60 标出发动机 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、高度 300 m。输送距离：HBT8018标出 150 m；LZ-60标出 100 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。看HBT8018请打开 /zh/products/hbt8018-concrete-pump/，看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Same label style does not mean the same metres. Conveying distance: HBT8018 lists 150 m. LZ-60 lists 100 m. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 型号行：HBT8018标出 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S；LZ-60标出 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。输送高度：HBT8018标出 450 m；LZ-60标出 300 m。HBT8018有、LZ-60没有的行：电机功率 132 kW。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does HBT8018 list the same model line as LZ-60?

answer.en: No. HBT8018 lists HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. LZ-60 lists LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018标出 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。LZ-60标出 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: No. HBT8018 lists 60 m³/h. LZ-60 lists 50 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018标出 60 m³/h。LZ-60标出 50 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does HBT8018 list the same pumping pressure as LZ-60?

answer.en: No. HBT8018 lists 40 MPa. LZ-60 lists 35 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete.
answer.zh: 不一样。HBT8018标出 40 MPa。LZ-60标出 35 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Why is motor power missing on LZ-60?

answer.en: The LZ-60 page does not list that label. HBT8018 lists 132 kW. Leave the missing entry blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete.
answer.zh: LZ-60这一页没有标出这个标题。HBT8018标出的是 132 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete画面里印出的数字。
